info.extra.text:
If something doesn’t work as expected:
- Ensure you are logged in and the browser window is still open
- Navigate to Products and retry
- Refresh the page if a table/search looks stale
- Run smaller batches to isolate a problematic product

info.history.details:

- Filter or search the detailed records directly
- Export upload outcomes and products needing review to Excel

info.login.details:
More details:
- If login fails, confirm credentials and try a different browser
- Keep the browser open; closing it ends the session
info.login.text: Choose your browser, enter your credentials, and sign in. After login, the app keeps using the same browser session for all automation.
info.login.title: Login
info.overview.details:
More details:
- Most screens reuse the same Selenium session after login
- Avoid clicking around in the admin panel while a batch is running
- If something looks stuck, check the browser window first
info.overview.note: Tip: Keep the browser window open while running uploads/scrapes.
info.overview.text: UltraBike automates bulk product maintenance in Pimbo through dedicated Orbea and KROSS workflows, lookup tools, and image collection.
info.overview.title: What this app does
info.safety.details:
More details:
- Don’t run two automations at the same time
- If a page looks inconsistent, refresh the browser and retry
info.safety.text: Don’t edit products manually in the same browser session while an automation task is running. Prefer short runs and verify results after completion.
info.safety.title: Good practices
info.settings.details:
More details:
- Update the KROSS download folder when needed
- Theme and language changes can be previewed before saving
- MagicAI title and description template names are configurable
info.settings.text: Configure paths, appearance, browser behavior, and product-processing options. Settings are stored in the local database.
info.settings.title: Settings
info.title: Info
info.translations.details:
More details:
- Use Refresh after edits if you don’t see changes reflected
- Keep translations consistent across brands to avoid mismatches

layout.info.automation.title: Orbea and KROSS
layout.info.automation.body: Choose sources and filters, collect product data, review the matches, then select which stages to upload to Pimbo. Saved collections can be loaded again.
layout.info.earnings.title: Earnings
layout.info.earnings.body: Log products by SKU and brand, track work sessions, and follow money goals. Analytics shows your recorded activity and projections; Records lets you filter, edit, and export entries.
layout.info.lookup.title: Product lookup
layout.info.lookup.body: Use the tabs to find names by code, export codes or product names, and check specifications. Load an Excel file where required and export the completed results.
layout.info.brands.title: Brand tools
layout.info.brands.body: Find ABUS, Castelli, or Oakley product URLs. Download Basso, Pinarello, or Castelli images into local folders. Each brand keeps its own input and run controls.
layout.info.translations.title: Translations
layout.info.translations.body: Search terms by category and add or edit translations used for product data.
layout.info.backups.title: Backups and updates
layout.info.backups.body: Settings contains encrypted backup and restore actions, update checks, folder paths, language, and appearance. Save or cancel your changes before leaving.
layout.info.practice.title: Good practices
layout.info.practice.body: Review selected products and stages before uploading. Use Activity to inspect a running job, open its output, or request a stop. Keep a backup before restoring local data.
